IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'SynchedAssetTypeRoleItem') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [integration].[SynchedAssetTypeRoleItem]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [SynchedAssetTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [IncludeInPropertyRequest] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRoleItem_IncludeInPropertyRequest] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [SourceIdField] [varchar](250) NOT NULL, [Active] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRoleItem_Active] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [ResponsibilityTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [ResolutionType] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRoleItem_ResolutionType] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [ResolutionFieldTypeID] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRoleItem] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRoleItem_IntegrationSynchedAssetType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [integration].[SynchedAssetTypeRoleItem] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRoleItem_IntegrationSynchedAssetType] FOREIGN KEY([SynchedAssetTypeID]) REFERENCES [integration].[SynchedAssetType] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [integration].[SynchedAssetTypeRoleItem] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRoleItem_IntegrationSynchedAssetType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRoleItem_ResponsibilityType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [integration].[SynchedAssetTypeRoleItem] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRoleItem_ResponsibilityType] FOREIGN KEY([ResponsibilityTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[ResponsibilityType] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [integration].[SynchedAssetTypeRoleItem] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRoleItem_ResponsibilityType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRoleItem') BEGIN CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRoleItem] ON [integration].[SynchedAssetTypeRoleItem] ( [SynchedAssetTypeID] ASC, [SourceIdField] ASC ) END
